QUOTE: The assembly is gated by `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, which is defined only under `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` and only when the compiler is GCC-compatible or ARMCC (`constant_time_impl.h:40-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler detection, which conveys that it is derived. It never explicitly says it is absent from mbedtls_config.h, but the mechanism is named.
